Property Description

  • Driveway

This four bedroom townhouse in a quiet cul-de-sac is within easy walking distance of the shops and station in Palmers Green, Bounds Green tube station, Broomfield Park and Arnos Park. In excellent condition, it has modern décor, fixtures and fittings.

PROPERTY DESCRIPTION

With 1,133 square feet of space set over three floors, this modern townhouse is ideally suited to contemporary lifestyles, with four bedrooms, two bathrooms, two additional WCs, and a large open plan living space on the ground floor. Comprising a large galley kitchen and a generous lounge area with ample space for sofas and a dining table, this c.25 ft by 15 ft room has direct access to the garden through glazed double doors. Decorated in stylish white, with dark green feature walls, kitchen cabinets, and metro-tiled splashback, it has downlighters and a welcoming wood floor, complemented by the wood kitchen worktop. with views to the front and rear garden, it’s a pleasant space with great natural light.

The kitchen is well-equipped, with Shaker-style fitted cabinets that line two walls and provide a huge amount of storage space as well as accommodating a range of integrated appliances. Also on this floor is a WC, neatly tucked under the stairs.

The first floor has two bedrooms – a large double with two windows and lovely leafy views at the front of the property, and a smaller bedroom at the rear with garden views. There’s also a WC, accessed from the landing. This layout is echoed on the second (top) floor, which has a large bedroom with an en suite bathroom and fitted wardrobe at the front, a smaller bedroom (currently used as a workspace) with fitted cupboards at the rear, and a shower room accessed from the hallway.

The house is in good condition throughout with double glazing, gas central heating, and stylish modern décor and contemporary fixtures and fittings including feature painted walls and wallpaper, downlighters, and smart wood floors.

The property is located towards the end of a quiet cul-de-sac. It has an off-street parking space at the front, and an attractive garden at the rear. This has been landscaped for year-round use, with a paved terrace adjacent to the house, a lawn and a deep flowerbed, and a stepping stone and gravel path to the garden studio which comprised an open, sheltered decked area with an electricity supply and space for sofas, and an enclosed shed.

Available from 1st July.

LOCAL LIFE

Westminster Drive is tucked away in a popular low-rise residential area just 500m as the crow flies from the centre of Palmers Green. It’s a short walk to the many shops, amenities and station in this thriving neighbourhood centre.

Palmers Green train station and Bounds Green Piccadilly Line tube station, both a brisk 15-minute walk from the property, provide direct journeys to King’s Cross and the West End respectively.

21-hectare Broomfield Park is just half a mile away. This fantastic open green space has stunning views of Alexandra Park and a wide range of features and facilities, including three lakes, a model boat pond, an orchard, a conservatory, a bandstand, and a playground and sports courts. It’s also a Site of Local Importance for Nature Conservation.
